## Detailed country context

Country-specific information that adds context to the summary indicators above.

<div class="country-note-groups">
<details class="country-note-group">
<summary>
<span>Programme and transmission context</span>
<small>4 notes</small>
</summary>
<div class="country-note-group__body">
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Subnational programme context</h4>
<p>Ecological stratification; 4 categories; altitute; Malaria is endemic and stable up to 1,200 metres; Malaria is epidemic prone between 1,200 and 1,600 metres; Only P. vivax is transmitted above 1,600 metres; There is no malaria transmission above 2,000 metres.</p>
</div>
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Cross-border context</h4>
<p>Mostly into Papua Indonesia</p>
</div>
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Mobile and migrant population context</h4>
<p>Mining and petroleum sector workers</p>
</div>
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>High-risk populations</h4>
<p>Mobile populations traveling from low endemic (or predominantly vivax malaria endemic) and epidemic prone areas in the highlands to (and from) highly endemic lowland areas, especially urban settlements in Madang and Morobe; People of all age groups living in epidemic-prone highland provinces during epidemic years; Pregnant women and young children (particularly those who are malnourished) living in highly endemic lowland areas.</p>
</div>
</div>
</details>
<details class="country-note-group">
<summary>
<span>Diagnosis and G6PD context</span>
<small>2 notes</small>
</summary>
<div class="country-note-group__body">
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Diagnostic approach</h4>
<p>Microscopy or RDT</p>
</div>
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>G6PD prevalence research</h4>
<p>Scope</p>
</div>
</div>
</details>
<details class="country-note-group">
<summary>
<span>Treatment and community-care context</span>
<small>2 notes</small>
</summary>
<div class="country-note-group__body">
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Rationale for ACT use</h4>
<p>Because CQ resistance and AQ resistance, but less resistance for Pv. Maybe for easier case management to use the same first-line for both Pf and Pv?</p>
</div>
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Community vivax-care context</h4>
<p>Referral after malaria testing and provision of ACT</p>
</div>
</div>
</details>
</div>
